Known Issues in Enterprise DLP Plugin 6.0.2

Known issues in Enterprise Data Loss Prevention (E-DLP) plugin 6.0.2.

PLUG-16720

On the Panorama management server, Enterprise DLP erroneously allows you to add a data profile to a rule.
Workaround: Contact Palo Alto Networks Support to remove the profile.

PAN-144897

Enterprise DLP data profile Thread ID/Name filters return no results.

DSS-17763

On the Panorama management server, custom data profiles are not listed after upgrade.
